name: elevated
title: Surfaces
description: Eight nested surface levels from Fluid Functionalism. Overlays read their substrate and lift so dialogs, selects, and drawers stay visible at any depth in light and dark mode. PrometheusProvider starts the ladder at surface 1. Panels use Lisse smooth corners by default.
